integrity: General statements have an analytic argument; exact finite verification is corroboration only, not an infinite proof. No independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to nonunimodular empty 3-dimensional lattice tetrahedra and positive integer dilations; general width bounds and nonempty simplices are not addressed. Novelty subject to prior-literature priority, particularly alternate Hermite normal form terminology.
title: Universal box polynomials and a sharp root threshold for dilated empty tetrahedra
